title: Sprint 5: Cinematic 3D Chest Reveal & Wanted Poster Export
goal: Build an emotional, cinematic 3D chest opening ceremony with Framer Motion and canvas confetti, enable 'Reply to Past' letter threading, and create a high-res Wanted Poster PNG canvas export.

issues.title: [UI/Animation] Cinematic 3D Treasure Chest Unboxing & Confetti Ceremony
issues.user_story: As a recipient opening a delivered letter, I want an immersive 3D chest unboxing ceremony with unlocking animations, sound effects, and confetti so opening the letter feels like discovering legendary treasure.

client_pages: client/src/pages/TreasureChest.jsx (ceremony state machine: locked -> unlocking -> opened -> reading)
client_components: client/src/components/letter/TreasureChest3D.jsx (Framer Motion 3D perspective transforms, chest lid spring animations)

acceptance_criteria: Unopened delivered letters show a pulsing, sealed treasure chest on sea sands.
Clicking 'Unlock Chest' triggers a key turn / lock break animation with gold particle bursts and optional creaking sound.
Parchment letter scrolls out smoothly from the chest with typewriter/fade-in text effects.
Chest theme accurately renders chosen style ('default', 'gold', 'scroll', 'davy_jones', 'alabasta', 'skypiea').
Animation can be safely skipped or replayed via a 'Replay Ceremony' button.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [UI Animation Test] Open /treasure/:id on delivered letter -> click 'Open Chest' -> verify state changes from 'locked' to 'opened' and confetti fires.
2. [Theme Test] Verify each of the 6 chest themes renders its distinct color palette, textures, and seal badges.
3. [Mobile Test] Verify 3D animations run at 60fps on mobile viewports with touch interaction.
4. [Accessibility Test] Verify prefers-reduced-motion media query presents an accessible instant reveal.

issues.title: [Feature] 'Reply to the Past' Letter Chain & Response Threading
issues.user_story: As a recipient who just read a delivered letter from years ago, I want a 'Reply to this Letter' button that pre-links our responses into a time-travel conversation thread.

client_components: client/src/components/letter/LetterThreadCard.jsx (render previous letter excerpt and reply link)

acceptance_criteria: Delivered letter page provides a prominent 'Reply across Time' CTA button.
Clicking opens /write with `replyTo` parameter pre-populating recipient email and referencing original letter subject.
Once the reply letter is delivered in the future, viewing it displays a timeline thread showing the original letter and the reply.
Original sender receives a notification when a reply capsule is sealed for them.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [API Test] Create Letter A -> deliver Letter A -> POST Letter B with `replyTo: Letter A._id` -> verify replyTo saved.
2. [UI Test] Navigate to /treasure/LetterA -> click 'Reply' -> verify /write loads with recipient and subject pre-filled.
3. [UI Test] Force deliver Letter B -> open /treasure/LetterB -> verify original Letter A snippet is displayed in conversation thread.
4. [Automated] Add reply threading assertions in server test suite.

issues.title: [Gamification] Interactive Canvas Wanted Poster PNG Card Exporter
issues.user_story: As a proud pirate scribe, I want to download or share my One Piece Wanted Poster as a high-resolution PNG image with my avatar, bounty, rank, and letters sealed count.

client_utils: client/src/lib/canvasPosterExport.js (HTML5 Canvas rendering with Pirata One font and parchment textures)
client_pages: client/src/pages/Profile.jsx (Export Poster button, Share to X/Socials button)

acceptance_criteria: Profile page includes a 'Download Bounty Poster' button.
Canvas renders authentic One Piece wanted poster aesthetic with user's avatar, 'DEAD OR ALIVE', custom pirate title, and formatted bounty (e.g., ฿50,000,000).
Generated image downloads as high-res PNG (`HeyFutureJasmine_Wanted_<username>.png`).
Supports native Web Share API on mobile devices for direct sharing to Instagram Stories / WhatsApp.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [Canvas Test] Trigger poster generation in /profile -> verify HTMLCanvasElement draws background texture, avatar image, and bounty text.
2. [Download Test] Click 'Download Poster' -> verify valid PNG Blob is triggered for download with correct dimensions (1200x1600px).
3. [Share Test] Trigger on mobile browser -> verify `navigator.share` is invoked with image file.
4. [Automated] Validate canvas generation function exports valid data URL.
